items.title: Sysco (SYY) Plans $29.1 Billion Acquisition
items.summary: Sysco (NYSE:SYY) has agreed to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot in a proposed US$29.1b transaction that could reshape its foodservice role. The planned deal would combine Sysco’s broadline distribution network with Restaurant Depot’s cash and carry wholesale warehouse model. The Federal Trade Commission is reviewing the proposed acquisition, and its decision will influence how the combined operation can compete.
